blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Electrostatics and Current Electricity) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 State Coulomb's law. Write it in vector form and show that the Coulomb forces between two charges are equal and opposite. How is the force changed when the charges are placed in a dielectric medium? (5 marks)
(Coulomb ka qanoon bayan karein. Ise vector shakal mein likhein aur dikhayein ke do charges ke darmiyan Coulomb forces barabar aur mukhalif hain. Charges ko dielectric medium mein rakhne se force kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Bayan: Do point charges ke darmiyan force un ki miqdaaron ke hasil-e-zarb ke seedha aur faasle ke murabba ke ulat mutanasib hai:
F ∝ q₁q₂/r², ya F = k q₁q₂/r² ... (9.1)
Force charges ko milane wali line par amal karti hai. k medium aur units ke system par munhasir hai. Free space aur SI units mein:
k = 1/4πε₀ ... (9.2), jahan ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻², is liye k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻².
F = (1/4πε₀)(q₁q₂/r²) ... (9.3)

Vector shakal: r̂₂₁ q₁ se q₂ ki taraf aur r̂₁₂ q₂ se q₁ ki taraf unit vector hai (Fig. 9.2).
F₂₁ = (1/4πε₀)(q₁q₂/r²) r̂₂₁ ... (9.5) (q₁ ki wajah se q₂ par)
F₁₂ = (1/4πε₀)(q₁q₂/r²) r̂₁₂ ... (9.6) (q₂ ki wajah se q₁ par)
Chunke r̂₂₁ = −r̂₁₂, is liye F₂₁ = −F₁₂: forces miqdaar mein barabar aur rukh mein mukhalif (bahami force). Charges ke nishan kashish ya dafa batate hain.

Medium ka asar: Insulator medium dielectric kehlata hai. Dielectric free space ke muqable mein force ko aik mustaqil factor, relative permittivity εᵣ (Table 9.1), se kam karta hai. Medium mein:
F = (1/4πε₀εᵣ)(q₁q₂/r²), yani free space se εᵣ guna kam.
Hawa ka εᵣ = 1.0006 hai, is liye Eq. 9.3 hawa ke liye bhi maamooli ghalti se durust hai.

book_ref.quote: To represent the direction of these forces, we introduce unit vectors.

blocks.prompt:
2 A charge q₁ = −20 μC is at the corner of a right angle. A charge q₂ = +40 μC is 0.20 m from q₁ along the x-axis and a charge q₃ = +30 μC is 0.30 m from q₁ along the y-axis. Find the magnitude and direction of the net force on q₁. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²) (3 marks)
(Charge q₁ = −20 μC qaima zaviye ke kone par hai. q₂ = +40 μC, q₁ se x-axis par 0.20 m, aur q₃ = +30 μC, q₁ se y-axis par 0.30 m door hai. q₁ par net force ki miqdaar aur simt nikalein. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))
blocks.explanation: q₁ par dono forces kashish wali aur aapas mein amoodi hain; har aik Coulomb ke qanoon se nikal kar rectangular components ki tarah milayein.

book_ref.quote: To find the resultant of F₁₂ and F₁₃, let us make free-body diagram

steps: θ = tan⁻¹(60/180) = 18.4°, q₁ aur q₂ ko milane wali line se
blocks.final_answer: q₁ par net force = 190 N, line q₁q₂ se 18.4° par (q₃ ki taraf)

blocks.prompt:
3 Define electric intensity and give its unit. What are electric field lines? Describe the field-line patterns of an isolated positive charge, two identical positive charges, two equal and opposite charges and parallel charged plates, and list the properties of field lines. (5 marks)
(Electric intensity ki definition aur unit likhein. Electric field lines kya hain? Akele positive charge, do yaksaan positive charges, do barabar aur mukhalif charges aur charged mutawazi plates ke field-line patterns bayan karein aur field lines ki khususiyaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Electric intensity: kisi nuqte par rakhe unit positive charge par lagne wali force: E = F/q ... (9.8). Yeh F ke rukh mein vector hai; unit N C⁻¹. Nez F = qE ... (9.9).

Field lines: Michael Faraday ka tasawwur; charged jism ke gird field ki simt aur taqat ka nazri naqsha (lines of force bhi kehlati hain). Kisi satah se amoodi guzarne wali lines ki tadaad per unit area E ki miqdaar ke mutanasib hai.

Patterns:
(1) Akela +q: positive test charge door dhakela jata hai, is liye lines radial bahar (Fig. 9.5); −q ke liye radial andar (Fig. 9.6). Charge ke qareeb lines ghani (taqatwar field), door phail jaati hain.
(2) Do yaksaan positive charges: lines murti hain aur aik doosre ko dhakelti lagti hain; beech mein zero field spot ya neutral zone (Fig. 9.7).
(3) Barabar aur mukhalif charges: lines positive se shuru ho kar negative par khatam; har nuqte par field dono ka resultant, tangent ke rukh mein (Fig. 9.8).
(4) Mutawazi plates: darmiyan mein lines mutawazi aur barabar faasle par, is liye field uniform (Fig. 9.9).

Khususiyaat:
• Lines positive charges se nikal kar negative par khatam hoti hain.
• Kisi nuqte par line ka tangent wahan E ki simt deta hai.
• Taqatwar field mein lines qareeb, kamzor mein door.
• Do lines kabhi aik doosre ko nahi kaat'tin, kyunke har nuqte par E ki aik hi simt hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: We are now in a position to summarize the properties of electric field lines.

blocks.prompt:
4 Two positive point charges of 25 μC and 4 μC are 2.8 m apart. Find the point on the line joining them where the electric field is zero, and the field that each charge produces there. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²) (3 marks)
(25 μC aur 4 μC ke do positive point charges 2.8 m door hain. Un ko milane wali line par woh nuqta nikalein jahan electric field sifr ho, aur wahan har charge ki field. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²))
blocks.explanation: Do yaksaan charges ke darmiyan dono fields mukhalif hain; sifr nuqta wahan hai jahan miqdaarein barabar hon, chhote charge ke qareeb.

book_ref.quote: Find the spot on the line joining the two charges where electric field is zero.

steps: P ko 4 μC se d faasle par lein: E₁ = E₂, yani 25/(2.8 − d)² = 4/d²
(Doosra jawab charges ke bahar hai jahan dono fields aik rukh mein hain aur khatam nahi hotin.)
Har charge ki field P par: 9 × 10⁹ × 4 × 10⁻⁶/0.64 = 5.6 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹ (jaanch: 9 × 10⁹ × 25 × 10⁻⁶/4 = 5.6 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹)
blocks.final_answer: E = 0, 4 μC charge se 0.8 m (25 μC se 2.0 m) par; wahan har field 5.6 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹, mukhalif rukh mein

blocks.prompt:
5 Define electric flux and write it as a scalar product. Explain the flux when the area is perpendicular, parallel and inclined to the field. Show that the total flux through a sphere with a point charge q at its centre is q/ε₀. (5 marks)
(Electric flux ki definition likhein aur ise scalar product ki shakal mein likhein. Area ke field par amoodi, mutawazi aur jhuke hone par flux bayan karein. Sabit karein ke markaz par point charge q wale sphere se kul flux q/ε₀ hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Electric flux: kisi area se guzarne wali field lines ki tadaad, φₑ. Area ko vector area A se zahir karte hain jis ki miqdaar A aur rukh area ke normal ke saath hai.

(a) Area lines par amoodi: EA lines guzarti hain, φₑ = EA (zyada se zyada).
(b) Area lines ke mutawazi: koi line nahi guzarti; E aur A amoodi, φₑ = EA cos 90° = 0.
(c) Area jhuka hua, normal E se θ par: lines par amoodi projection A cos θ, is liye φₑ = EA cos θ.
Aam tor par φₑ = EA cos θ = E·A ... (9.10). Flux scalar hai; SI unit N m² C⁻¹.

Sphere se flux: Charge q radius r wale sphere ke markaz par hai (Fig. 9.12). Satah ko n chhote hamwaar patches ΔA₁, ΔA₂, …, ΔAₙ mein baantein (vector areas bahar ki taraf). Kul flux:
φₑ = E₁·ΔA₁ + E₂·ΔA₂ + … + Eₙ·ΔAₙ ... (9.11)
Har patch par E, ΔA ke rukh mein (θ = 0°) aur miqdaar barabar:
E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²) ... (9.12)
φₑ = E(ΔA₁ + … + ΔAₙ) = E × 4πr²
φₑ = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²) × 4πr²
φₑ = q/ε₀ ... (9.13)

Sphere ko gherne wali kisi bhi band satah S ka flux yahi hai (Fig. 9.13), is liye kul flux band satah ki shakal par munhasir nahi; sirf medium aur andar ke charge par.

book_ref.quote: Let us calculate the electric flux through a closed surface, in shape of a sphere of radius r

blocks.prompt:
6 A flat sheet of area 0.25 m² is in a uniform field of 2 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹. Find the flux through it when (i) its normal makes 30° with the field (ii) the sheet is parallel to the field. (iii) Find also the total flux through a closed surface enclosing a charge of 5 μC. (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²) (3 marks)
(0.25 m² ki hamwaar sheet 2 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹ ki uniform field mein hai. Flux nikalein jab (i) us ka normal field se 30° par ho (ii) sheet field ke mutawazi ho. (iii) 5 μC charge ko gherne wali band satah se kul flux bhi nikalein. (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²))
blocks.explanation: φₑ = EA cos θ lagayein, θ E aur normal ka angle; band satah ke liye sirf andar ka charge ahem hai.

book_ref.quote: Figure 9.11(c) shows the case when A is neither perpendicular nor parallel to field lines

steps: (ii) Sheet E ke mutawazi: normal E se 90° par, φₑ = 0
blocks.final_answer: (i) 4.33 × 10³ N m² C⁻¹ (ii) sifr (iii) 5.65 × 10⁵ N m² C⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
7 State Gauss's law and derive it for a number of point charges inside a closed surface. Use it to find the electric field at a point outside a charged conducting sphere. (5 marks)
(Gauss ka qanoon bayan karein aur band satah ke andar kai point charges ke liye derive karein. Is se charged conducting sphere ke bahar kisi nuqte par electric field nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Derivation: Band satah ke andar point charges q₁, q₂, …, qₙ hain (Fig. 9.14). Har charge ka band satah se flux q/ε₀ hai, shakal kuch bhi ho, is liye:
φₑ = q₁/ε₀ + q₂/ε₀ + … + qₙ/ε₀
φₑ = (1/ε₀)(q₁ + q₂ + … + qₙ)
φₑ = Q/ε₀ ... (9.14), Q andar band kul charge.
Gauss ka qanoon: Kisi bhi band satah se kul electric flux us mein band kul charge ka 1/ε₀ guna hai.

Gaussian surface: us nuqte se guzarti khayali band satah jahan E chahiye, aise chuni jati hai ke flux aasani se nikle.

Charged conducting sphere ki field: R radius ke conducting sphere par charge q satah par yaksaan phaila hai (Fig. 9.15). Symmetry se E radial aur har hum-markaz sphere par barabar. r > R radius ka Gaussian sphere lein.
Flux: φₑ = E × 4πr²
Gauss: φₑ = q/ε₀
E × 4πr² = q/ε₀
E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²)
Bahar field aisi hai jaise saara charge markaz par ho. Satah ke bilkul bahar (r = R):
E = (1/4πε₀)(q/R²) ... (9.15); vector shakal E = (1/4πε₀)(q/R²) r̂.

book_ref.quote: The area of the Gaussian sphere is 4πr², and because E is uniform over the sphere

blocks.prompt:
8 A conducting sphere of radius 0.15 m carries a charge of 3 μC. Find (i) the electric field just outside its surface (ii) the field at 0.45 m from its centre (iii) the total flux through a Gaussian sphere of radius 0.45 m. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻², ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²) (3 marks)
(0.15 m radius ke conducting sphere par 3 μC charge hai. Nikalein: (i) satah ke bilkul bahar field (ii) markaz se 0.45 m par field (iii) 0.45 m radius ke Gaussian sphere se kul flux. (k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻², ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C² N⁻¹ m⁻²))
blocks.explanation: Bahar saara charge markaz par samjhein; flux sirf andar ke charge par munhasir hai, radius par nahi.

book_ref.quote: Consider a conducting sphere of radius R containing a charge q.

steps: (ii) E = 9 × 10⁹ × 3 × 10⁻⁶ / 0.2025 = 1.3 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹ (r teen guna, E nawaan hissa)
blocks.final_answer: (i) 1.2 × 10⁶ N C⁻¹ (ii) 1.3 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹ (iii) 3.4 × 10⁵ N m² C⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
9 Define electric potential energy difference and potential difference between two points in a uniform field, and the volt. Derive the relation between electric intensity and potential difference between two parallel plates, and show that V m⁻¹ = N C⁻¹. (5 marks)
(Uniform field mein do nuqton ke darmiyan electric potential energy difference aur potential difference, aur volt ki definition likhein. Do mutawazi plates ke darmiyan electric intensity aur potential difference ka taaluq derive karein aur dikhayein ke V m⁻¹ = N C⁻¹.)
blocks.explanation:
Potential energy difference: Do mukhalif charged mutawazi plates uniform field E deti hain (Fig. 9.16). Positive charge q ko field ke khilaf equilibrium mein (yaksaan velocity) A se B tak qE ke barabar aur mukhalif force F se le jaya jata hai. Kaam W_AB us ki electrical P.E. barhata hai:
ΔU = U_B − U_A = W_AB ... (9.16)

Potential difference: unit positive charge ko equilibrium mein A se B le jane ka kaam:
ΔV = V_B − V_A = W_AB/q = ΔU/q ... (9.17), yani ΔU = qΔV ... (9.18)
Unit: 1 volt = 1 joule/1 coulomb ... (9.19). Potential aur potential difference scalars hain.

E se taaluq: V_B − V_A = W_AB/q ... (9.21)
Yahan W_AB = Fd = −qEd (equilibrium ke liye F, qE ke mukhalif).
V_B − V_A = −qEd/q = −Ed
E = −(V_B − V_A)/d = −ΔV/d ... (9.22)
Bohat chhote faasle Δd ke liye:
E = −ΔV/Δd ... (9.23)
ΔV/Δd potential gradient hai (field line ke saath faasle ke lehaaz se potential ki zyada se zyada tabdeeli). E potential gradient ka manfi hai; manfi nishan batata hai ke E ghatte potential ki taraf hai.

Unit: 1 V m⁻¹ = 1 (J C⁻¹)/m = 1 (N m)/(m C) = 1 N C⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: In this section, we will establish a relation between electric intensity and potential difference.

blocks.prompt:
10 Two parallel plates 4 mm apart are connected to a 600 V supply. Find (i) the electric intensity between them (ii) the force on an electron between the plates (iii) the work done in carrying a proton from the negative to the positive plate. (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) (3 marks)
(4 mm faasle wali do mutawazi plates 600 V supply se judi hain. Nikalein: (i) un ke darmiyan electric intensity (ii) plates ke darmiyan electron par force (iii) proton ko negative se positive plate tak le jane ka kaam. (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C))
blocks.explanation: Field uniform hai, is liye E = ΔV/Δd; force F = qE aur kaam W = qΔV.

book_ref.quote: These are connected to a battery of 12 volts. Find the magnitude of electric field intensity between them.

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the motion of an electron released from rest at the negative plate of two charged parallel plates: find its acceleration and the speed with which it reaches the positive plate. What is its path if it enters perpendicular to the field? Define the electron volt. (5 marks)
(Do charged mutawazi plates mein negative plate se saakin chhore gaye electron ki harkat bayan karein: us ka acceleration aur positive plate tak pohanchne ki speed nikalein. Agar woh field par amoodi dakhil ho to us ka raasta kaisa hoga? Electron volt ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Field aur force: Do mukhalif charged mutawazi plates positive se negative plate ki taraf uniform field deti hain. Potential difference V aur faasla d ho to:
E = V/d ... (9.27)
Charge q par force F = qE ... (9.26). Positive charge E ke saath, negative charge (electron) E ke mukhalif, positive plate ki taraf chalta hai.

Acceleration: F = ma se
a = F/m = qE/m
Electron ke liye q = e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg.

Aakhri speed: Negative plate se saakin (vi = 0) chhora jaye to S = d tay karta hai. Motion ki teesri equation se:
2aS = vf² − vi², yani v² = 2ad aur v = √(2ad)
(Isi tarah: P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka izafa: eV = ½mv².)
Text ki misaal: V = 20 V, d = 2 × 10⁻² m se E = 1000 N C⁻¹, a = 1.76 × 10¹⁴ m s⁻², v² = 7.04 × 10¹² m² s⁻², v = 2.65 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹.

Field ke aar paar raasta: Agar charged zarra uniform field par amoodi dakhil ho to ufuqi velocity mustaqil aur amoodi velocity electric force se accelerate hoti hai, is liye raasta parabolic, ufuqi phainke projectile jaisa. Positive zarra negative plate ki taraf, negative zarra positive plate ki taraf murta hai. Field ke saath chale to raasta seedha.

Electron volt: woh energy jo electron aik volt potential difference se guzar kar hasil ya zaya karta hai. ΔK.E. = eΔV = (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)(1 V), is liye
1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J ... (9.25)

book_ref.quote: To understand the effect of uniform electric field on the motion of charged particles

blocks.prompt:
12 Two parallel plates 1.5 cm apart have a potential difference of 45 V. An electron is released from rest at the negative plate. Find (i) the field between the plates (ii) the acceleration of the electron (iii) its speed on reaching the positive plate and its kinetic energy in eV. (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg) (3 marks)
(1.5 cm faasle wali do mutawazi plates ke darmiyan 45 V hai. Negative plate se electron saakin chhora jata hai. Nikalein: (i) plates ke darmiyan field (ii) electron ka acceleration (iii) positive plate par us ki speed aur eV mein kinetic energy. (e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg))
blocks.explanation: E = V/d, phir a = eE/m, phir vi = 0 aur S = d ke saath motion ki teesri equation.

book_ref.quote: If the electron is released from the negative plate, the velocity gained by it when it reaches positive plate

blocks.final_answer: (i) 3000 N C⁻¹ (ii) 5.27 × 10¹⁴ m s⁻² (iii) 3.98 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹; K.E. = 45 eV

blocks.prompt:
13 What is meant by drift velocity? Why is a current set up almost instantly although the drift velocity is small? Derive the relation I = nAvq for the current through a conductor. What is conventional current? (5 marks)
(Drift velocity se kya muraad hai? Drift velocity kam hone ke bawajood current taqreeban foran kyun qaim hota hai? Conductor mein current ke liye I = nAvq derive karein. Conventional current kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Drift velocity: Conductor ko battery se jorne par andar electric field banti hai aur aazad electrons par −E ke rukh mein force lagti hai. Woh atoms se musalsal takrate aur lattice ko energy dete hain, is liye seedhi line mein accelerate nahi hote; −E ke rukh mein aik average velocity, drift velocity, hasil karte hain (bohat kam). Yahi drift current banati hai.

Foran current: Switch ON karte hi circuit ke tamam aazad electrons aik saath drift shuru karte hain; hamsayon ko dhakelte hain aur khalal taqreeban foran phailta hai, is liye bulb foran jalta hai.

Current: I = Q/t ... (9.28); unit ampere (1 C s⁻¹).

I = nAvq ki derivation: L lambai aur A cross-section ka hissa lein (hajm AL) (Fig. 9.21). Per unit volume n carriers hon to hisse mein nAL carriers; har aik ka charge q:
Q = nALq ... (9.29)
Drift velocity v ho to tamam carriers ke aik face se nikalne ka waqt
t = L/v
I = Q/t se:
I = nALq/(L/v)
I = nAvq ... (9.30)

Conventional current: positive charges ka farzi bahao jis ka asar asal manfi charges ke bahao jaisa ho. Yeh zyada se kam potential ki taraf (source ke bahar positive se negative terminal ki taraf) behta hai; I hamesha conventional current hai.

book_ref.quote: Suppose that charge carriers move towards left face of the segment

blocks.prompt:
14 A copper wire of cross-sectional area 1.5 × 10⁻⁶ m² carries a current of 4.5 A. Find (i) the drift velocity of the electrons (ii) the charge passing through the wire in 2 minutes (iii) the number of electrons passing in that time. (n = 8.5 × 10²⁸ m⁻³, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) (3 marks)
(1.5 × 10⁻⁶ m² cross-section wali copper taar mein 4.5 A current hai. Nikalein: (i) electrons ki drift velocity (ii) 2 minute mein guzarne wala charge (iii) us waqt mein guzarne wale electrons. (n = 8.5 × 10²⁸ m⁻³, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C))
blocks.explanation: I = nAvq se v nikalein; phir Q = It aur N = Q/e.

book_ref.quote: calculate the drift velocity of the electrons in the wire

blocks.prompt:
15 State Ohm's law. Define resistivity and conductivity with their units. Explain why the resistance of a metal increases with temperature, define the temperature coefficient of resistance and derive α in terms of resistivity. (5 marks)
(Ohm ka qanoon bayan karein. Resistivity aur conductivity ki definitions units ke saath likhein. Wazeh karein ke dhaat ki resistance temperature se kyun barhti hai, temperature coefficient of resistance ki definition likhein aur α ko resistivity ki shakal mein derive karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ohm ka qanoon: Conductor mein current us par lage potential difference ke seedha mutanasib hai, ba-shart ke physical haalat na badle: V ∝ I, V = RI ... (9.31). 1 Ω: 1 V par 1 A.

Resistivity: R ∝ L/A, is liye R = ρL/A ... (9.32), aur ρ = RA/L ... (9.33). Resistivity maadde ke aik metre cube ki resistance hai; unit Ω m. Resistance aik khaas taar ki, resistivity maadde ki khususiyat hai.
Conductance G = 1/R; conductivity σ = 1/ρ ... (9.34), unit Ω⁻¹ m⁻¹ (mho m⁻¹).

Temperature ka asar: Resistance aazad electrons ke lattice atoms se takraon ki wajah se hai. Temperature barhne se atoms ki thartharahat ka amplitude barhta hai, collision cross-section bara hota hai, takrao zyada hote hain aur resistance barhti hai.

Temperature coefficient: Resistance ki tabdeeli wasee range mein taqreeban seedhi (linear) hai (Fig. 9.22). Har kelvin par resistance ki kasri tabdeeli
α = (Rt − Ro)/(Ro t) ... (9.35)
jahan Ro aur Rt 0 °C aur t °C par resistances hain. Chunke
Rt = ρt L/A aur Ro = ρo L/A ... (9.36)
Eq. 9.35 mein rakhne se (L/A kat jata hai):
α = (ρt − ρo)/(ρo t) ... (9.37)
Unit K⁻¹. Germanium, silicon wagheira ka α manfi hai.

book_ref.quote: The resistivity of a substance depends upon the temperature also.

blocks.prompt:
16 A copper wire is 20 m long and has a cross-sectional area of 0.5 × 10⁻⁶ m². Taking the resistivity of copper 1.69 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m as its value at 0 °C and α = 0.0039 K⁻¹, find (i) its resistance at 0 °C (ii) its resistance at 80 °C. (3 marks)
(Copper ki taar 20 m lambi aur 0.5 × 10⁻⁶ m² cross-section wali hai. Copper ki resistivity 1.69 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m ko 0 °C ki qeemat aur α = 0.0039 K⁻¹ lete hue nikalein: (i) 0 °C par resistance (ii) 80 °C par resistance.)
blocks.explanation: Ro ke liye R = ρL/A, phir α = (Rt − Ro)/(Ro t) ko Rt = Ro(1 + αt) likhein.

book_ref.quote: Compute the resistivity of iron.

blocks.prompt:
17 What is electrical power? Derive P = VI for the power supplied by a battery to a resistor, and obtain the other two forms of the power dissipated in a resistor. (5 marks)
(Electrical power kya hai? Battery ki taraf se resistor ko di gayi power ke liye P = VI derive karein aur resistor mein zaya power ki baaqi do shaklein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Emf ε wali battery resistance R ke saath series mein hai (Fig. 9.23). Steady current I behta hai aur R par steady p.d. V hai; terminal A (positive pole se jura) B se zyada potential par hai. Battery charge ko musalsal V ke 'oopar' uthati hai.

Charge Q ko p.d. V se guzarne ka kaam (battery ki di hui energy):
W = V × Q ... (9.38)

Electrical power woh sharah hai jis se battery electrical energy deti hai:
Power = Di gayi energy/Waqt = V(Q/t)
Chunke I = Q/t:
Electrical power = V × I ... (9.39)
Yeh voltage V par current I dene wale source ki power ka aam taaluq hai. Energy ke tahaffuz se R mein zaya power bhi P = VI hai.

Doosri shaklein: V = IR rakhne se P = I²R; I = V/R rakhne se P = V²/R.
Yani P = VI, P = I²R, P = V²/R ... (9.40)
V volts aur I amperes mein ho to P watts mein.

blocks.prompt:
19 Define emf and internal resistance. For a cell of emf E and internal resistance r connected to an external resistance R, derive E = IR + Ir and interpret it in terms of energy. Distinguish the emf from the terminal potential difference. (5 marks)
(Emf aur internal resistance ki definitions likhein. Emf E aur internal resistance r wale cell ko bairooni resistance R se jorne par E = IR + Ir derive karein aur energy ke lehaaz se tashreeh karein. Emf aur terminal potential difference mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Emf: Cell steady current qaim rakhta hai; is se guzarne wala charge Q kam potential wale sire se dakhil ho kar zyada potential wale se nikalta hai, is liye cell ko energy W deni parti hai. Emf cell ki taraf se unit charge ko di gayi energy hai:
E = W/Q ... (9.41)
Yeh force nahi; unit J C⁻¹ = volt. Energy cell ke andar chemical energy ke badalne se aati hai.

Internal resistance: cell ki apni resistance, electrodes ke darmiyan electrolyte ki wajah se. Cell khalis emf E aur series mein r ke barabar hai (Fig. 9.25).

Derivation: Bairooni resistance R ke saath (Fig. 9.26) kul resistance R + r hai, is liye
I = E/(R + r)
E = IR + Ir ... (9.42)
IR = V current I ke saath terminal potential difference hai. Switch khula ho (current nahi) to voltmeter E parhta hai; current ho to V = E − Ir, E se Ir kam.

Energy ki tashreeh: E unit charge ki woh energy hai jo cell mein − se + tak milti hai. Is mein se Ir cell ke andar aur IR bahar ki resistance mein zaya hoti hai.

Emf aur p.d.: emf sabab aur potential difference asar hai; emf current na lene par bhi mojood, magar current na ho to conductor par p.d. sifr.

21 Show that Kirchhoff's first rule follows from conservation of charge and derive Kirchhoff's second rule from conservation of energy for a loop containing two cells and two resistors. Give the sign rules for potential changes and the steps for solving a network with loop currents. (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke Kirchhoff ka pehla usool charge ke tahaffuz se nikalta hai, aur do cells aur do resistors wale loop ke liye energy ke tahaffuz se doosra usool derive karein. Potential ki tabdeeliyon ke nishanaat ke usool aur loop currents se network hal karne ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pehla usool: Kisi nuqte par milne wale tamam currents ka majmooa sifr hai, ΣI = 0 ... (9.43) (nuqte ki taraf positive, door negative). Nuqta A par chaar taarein (Fig. 9.27), I₁, I₂ andar aur I₃, I₄ bahar:
I₁ + I₂ + (−I₃) + (−I₄) = 0, yani I₁ + I₂ = I₃ + I₄ ... (9.44)
Yani andar aane wale currents ka majmooa bahar jane walon ke barabar. Agar nuqte par charge ka koi source ya sink na ho to andar aane wala charge bahar jane wale ke barabar: charge ka tahaffuz.

Doosra usool: Fig. 9.28 ke band circuit mein E₁ > E₂, is liye current I counter-clockwise. Charge Q:
• E₁ mein − se + guzar kar E₁Q energy hasil karta hai;
• E₂ mein + se − guzar kar −E₂Q energy khota hai;
• R₁ aur R₂ mein (zyada se kam potential) −IR₁Q aur −IR₂Q khota hai.
Wapas shuru ke nuqte par energy ki kul tabdeeli sifr hai (energy ka tahaffuz):
E₁Q − IR₁Q − E₂Q − IR₂Q = 0
E₁ − IR₁ − E₂ − IR₂ = 0 ... (9.45)
Doosra usool: band circuit mein potential ki tabdeeliyon ka algebraic majmooa sifr hai.

Nishanaat (durust): cell − se +: +E; + se −: −E. Resistor current ke rukh mein: −IR; current ke khilaf: +IR.

Tareeqa: (1) Circuit banayein. (2) Loops aise chunen ke har resistance kam az kam aik dafa aaye. (3) Har loop mein loop current farz karein, sab aik rukh mein. (4) Loop equations likhein (kam se zyada potential positive, zyada se kam negative); mushtarik resistor mein loop currents ka farq. (5) Na-maloom hal karein.

book_ref.quote: According to the law of conservation of energy, the total change in energy of our system is zero.

blocks.prompt:
23 Describe the Wheatstone bridge circuit. Derive the condition for no current through the galvanometer, and explain how the bridge is used with the null method to find an unknown resistance. (5 marks)
(Wheatstone bridge circuit bayan karein. Galvanometer mein current na hone ki shart derive karein aur wazeh karein ke null method se bridge na-maloom resistance kaise nikalta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Circuit: Chaar resistances R₁, R₂, R₃ aur R₄ mesh ABCDA banati hain (Fig. 9.30). Battery A aur C ke darmiyan aur hassas galvanometer (resistance R_g) B aur D ke darmiyan. Switch band karne par aam tor par galvanometer mein current behta hai; hum current na hone ki shart nikalte hain.

Balance ki shart (durust): Galvanometer mein current na ho to aik current I R₁ aur R₂ (raasta ABC) mein aur doosra current I′ R₃ aur R₄ (raasta ADC) mein behta hai. Galvanometer mein current na hone ka matlab B aur D aik potential par hain. Is liye A se B ka drop A se D ke drop ke barabar, aur B se C ka drop D se C ke barabar:
IR₁ = I′R₃
IR₂ = I′R₄
Pehli ko doosri se taqseem karein:
R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄ ... (9.51)
Jab Eq. 9.51 poori ho galvanometer deflection nahi dikhata, aur ulta bhi.

Na-maloom resistance (null method): R₁, R₂, R₃ maloom aur qabil-e-tabdeel, R₄ na-maloom. Inhein tab tak badlein jab tak galvanometer deflection na dikhaye; phir
R₄ = R₂R₃/R₁
Null par galvanometer mein current nahi, is liye us ki apni resistance ka asar nahi, aur hassas galvanometer (taqreeban 10⁻⁶ A) balance ko wazeh karta hai.

book_ref.quote: If we connect three resistances R₁, R₂ and R₃ of known adjustable values and a fourth resistance R₄ of unknown value

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Eqs. 9.48 aur 9.49 (−I₁R₁ = I₁R₃ wagheira) durust nahi, kyunke un mein battery ka current shamil nahi. Yahan seedha tareeqa hai: galvanometer mein current sifr ho to B aur D ka potential barabar, is liye IR₁ = I′R₃ aur IR₂ = I′R₄. Taqseem karne se wahi nateeja R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄ milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
25 Why can an ordinary voltmeter not measure the emf of a cell exactly? Explain the potential divider, and derive the expressions used with a potentiometer to measure an unknown emf and to compare the emfs of two cells. Why is the method accurate? (5 marks)
(Aam voltmeter cell ki emf theek theek kyun nahi naap sakta? Potential divider wazeh karein, aur potentiometer se na-maloom emf naapne aur do cells ki emfs ka muqabla karne ke formulas derive karein. Yeh tareeqa durust kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Voltmeter ki kami: Voltmeter sahi tab parhta hai jab current na le; agar us ki resistance bohat zyada na ho to circuit ka current aur p.d. badal deta hai. Ideal voltmeter ki resistance la-mehdood chahiye. Digital voltmeter aur CRO taqreeban current nahi lete magar mehenge hain; potentiometer saada aur durust hai.

Potential divider: Taar AB ki shakal ke resistor R par sliding contact C hai (Fig. 9.31). R par emf E ki battery I = E/R chalati hai. A aur C ke darmiyan resistance r ho to drop rI = rE/R; C ke A se B jane par yeh 0 se E tak badalta hai.

Na-maloom emf (Fig. 9.32): R seedhi yaksaan taar hai. Cell Eₓ ko A aur slider C ke darmiyan galvanometer ke zariye jora jata hai, Eₓ aur divider ke positive terminals dono A par. C ko tab tak hilayein jab tak galvanometer deflection na dikhaye; tab Eₓ, A aur C ke darmiyan p.d. ke barabar hai. Yaksaan taar mein resistance ∝ lambai, is liye
Eₓ = E r/R = E l/L ... (9.52)
L taar AB ki lambai aur l balancing lambai AC. Eₓ, E se zyada na ho warna null point nahi milega.

Do emfs ka muqabla: Dono cells ki balancing lambaiyan l₁ aur l₂:
E₁ = E l₁/L aur E₂ = E l₂/L
Taqseem: E₁/E₂ = l₁/l₂ ... (9.53)

Usool aur durusti: Steady current ke saath yaksaan taar par potential drop lambai ke mutanasib hai (V ∝ l). Emf null point par naapi jati hai jab cell se current nahi liya jata, is liye potentiometer potential naapne ke sab se durust tareeqon mein se hai.

book_ref.quote: Such an arrangement also known as potential divider can be used to measure the unknown emf

blocks.prompt:
27 What are thermistors and light dependent resistors? Explain why their resistance changes with temperature and light respectively, how they are made, and how each is used in a voltage divider to work a switch or an alarm. (5 marks)
(Thermistors aur light dependent resistors kya hain? Wazeh karein ke in ki resistance bil-tarteeb temperature aur roshni se kyun badalti hai, yeh kaise bante hain, aur har aik voltage divider mein switch ya alarm chalane ke liye kaise istemal hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Thermistor: hararat se mutassir resistor. Aksar ka temperature coefficient manfi: temperature barhne se resistance kam, kyunke zyada energy se charge carriers (electrons ya holes) aasani se chalte hain (positive coefficient wale bhi milte hain). Dhaati oxides (manganese, nickel, cobalt, copper, iron) ki semiconductor ceramic ko zyada pressure par garam kar ke, beads, rods ya washers bana kar paka kar tayyar kiye jaate hain.
Istemal: temperature naapna aur sensing (thermometers, gaari ke coolant sensors; 10 K ke qareeb durust), temperature compensation, inrush current limiting.
Voltage divider / fire alarm (Fig. 9.35, durust): thermistor B aur earth ke darmiyan hai. Garam hone par resistance girti hai, is liye us par voltage (B ka potential) kam hota hai; NOT gate ka input low, output high aur siren ON.

LDR (photo resistor): roshni barhne se resistance kam hone wala resistor; cadmium sulphide jaise semiconductor se, insulating plate par khaas pattern mein.
Usool: andhere mein kam aazad electrons, is liye resistance zyada; roshni ke photons bahar ke electrons ko energy de kar aazad karte hain, conductivity barhti aur resistance girti hai.
Voltage divider (Fig. 9.36): LDR 100 kΩ ke standard resistor ke saath series mein. Andhere mein us ki resistance bohat zyada, is liye zyada voltage us par (voltmeter ki zyada reading); roshni mein resistance bohat kam aur reading kam. Darmiyani nuqta B ko NPN transistor ya NOT gate se jorne par LDR roshni se chalne wala switch ban jata hai (street lights shaam ko ON, subah OFF). LDR camera ka exposure time bhi set karte hain.
